method.cases: the four admitted [4,8] families, the two retained-loop [32,16] four-trip cases, the counted arm of the recorded pair and its mechanically unrolled twin; every case was run again on the device with a fresh Triton cache and pass dumps enabled

classification.counts_are_not_attribution: a conversion count or a PTX counter is evidence only together with the conversion identity that the count belongs to
classification.eliminated: the conversion is removed by a named pass while the module still holds tensor operations, and no equivalent definition took over its consumers in that transition
classification.folded: the conversion carries no layout change (its source and target encoding resolve equal), or the transition that removes it also recomputes the value for its former consumers
classification.origin: a conversion present in the first snapshot has no creating pass in the dump; its origin is reported as before-the-first-snapshot rather than credited to the first pass
classification.stage_boundary: the tensor-dialect stages end at the first transition whose left snapshot holds a tensor-dialect operation and whose right snapshot holds none; the conversion operations cannot outlive that boundary
classification.surviving: the conversion is still present in the last snapshot of the tensor dialects; it is lowered, not eliminated, by the transition that converts the tensor operations to LLVM
classification.unattributed: the conversion appears before the first snapshot, or disappears without a matched transition, or its transition has no named pass

method.device_runs: each case re-emitted its kernel with the recorded symirc digest (5915fbda...), compiled with a fresh cache, launched once, and compared the complete output against the recorded reference bytes
method.per_conversion_tracking: the driver pairs conversions between adjacent snapshots by source location and resolved source/target encodings, keeps a moved fragment alive across the move, and attributes birth and death to the transition that produced them, numbered by occurrence within the pass name

observer_limitations.counterexample: %_sir_x_d0_0 = ttg.convert_layout %_sir_x_d0 : tensor<4xi32, #blocked2> -> tensor<4xi32, #ttg.slice<{dim = 1, parent = #blocked3}>> reads as #blocked2 -> #ttg.slice<{dim = 1, parent = #blocked3}> and changes an encoding; the removed _TENSOR_ENCODING regular expression read only '#blocked2' and reported source equal to target
deliberate_limits: a tensor type wrapped across physical lines reports no encoding rather than a truncated one
an encoding name is not validated against a dialect
a quoted generic name is rewritten to the custom form only at the root of an encoding
an alias a snapshot defines twice keeps its last definition
observer_limitations.effect: the recogniser scans every tensor type on a line with a bracket counter, splits the type body on the commas outside every bracket, and resolves the trailing component through _resolve_encoding_text, so an alias, an encoding printed inline in parameterized form at any nesting depth, and the generic quoted spelling are all read as the layout they denote; _encoding_identity compares the resolved text, so two spellings of one layout are not a change
observer_limitations.handling: the fields this reading feeds were regenerated with the library named in the rederivation block: conversions[].library_layout_changed and notable_transitions[].library_effective_delta moved, and stages[].library_layout_changed_count was re-derived without change (0 everywhere, as before)
observer_limitations.observed_impact: the fixed library agrees with the driver's own bracket-matching parser on all 102 Track A conversion occurrences (0 disagreements); 46 of the 102 move from ineffective to effective, so the eight device cases read 5/8/12/8/12/21/12/12 effective conversions and the library-effective total is 90, equal to the record's 90 eliminated conversions

observer_limitations.counterexample: Gluon track C: 10 of 14 conversions report region 'module' at snapshot 1, while the same lines are inside @generated_region_kernel
observer_limitations.effect: one scope is popped per line that starts with a brace, so an operation printed in generic form ('tt.reduce' ... ({ ... }) : ...) drifts the scope stack; values inside a function then report 'module', and repackaged regions appear as moves
observer_limitations.handling: the driver tracks scopes by pushing only on a line that ends with '{' and popping by the net brace count; the correction now also exists in the library from parallel work, and the two readings agree on every conversion occurrence of these dumps
observer_limitations.observed_impact: the library reading reports 86 conversions as moved between regions in the 12 Track C dumps; the corrected map places every one of them inside tt.func / scf.for, and the only region change is the loop the same transition folds away

rematerialization.matcher: test.lib.tensor_compiler_observation.observe_rematerialization through observe_pass_dumps(..., rematerialization=True): a confirmed recomputation needs an equivalent surviving producer, strictly more pure definitions with that expression, a former consumer the original lost, and a redirected consumer that structurally matches a former one

proposed_generation_change.cost: one plan family plus its generation test, one device run, and the control; larger than a few lines, so it is proposed rather than done
proposed_generation_change.recipe: add a Gluon plan family on the retained [32,16] four-trip region: inside the loop body, a tt.broadcast whose source is a loop-carried value, its result viewed in a second layout for exactly one consumer while a second consumer keeps the producer's own layout. The pinned encodings keep the conversion from being redundant, and the second consumer keeps the original broadcast alive, which is the matcher's requirement that the original producer survives
proposed_generation_change.target: a value recomputed for redirected consumers by a named pass, in the shape RemoveLayoutConversions' backwardRematerialization or hoistConvertOnTopOfExtOrBroadcast accepts
proposed_generation_change.verification: observe_pass_dumps(..., rematerialization=True) must report confirmed >= 1 at a named pass transition; a control with the consumers in one layout must report 0; PTX/LLIR counters are recorded beside it as support, never as the attribution

rematerialization.why_not_reached: every transition the matcher reports as unattributed either adds no repeated operation at all, or adds one whose surviving original keeps every consumer: the additions are the same computation printed again after a structural lowering collapsed region-scoped names, or a no-operand hardware query, and no former consumer is redirected to any of them
